title: SpiceRack Circuit IR
description: Backend-neutral intermediate representation for SPICE circuits. This is the contract between Schemify's Zig editor and the SpiceRack simulation backend.

raw_dialect.description: The dialect the raw_spice lines are written in, set by the importer; such lines reach only that dialect. Absent or null: generic SPICE.

globals.description: .global nodes: one net under the same name in every subcircuit. Absent: none.

sections.description: Library-section definitions (SPICE .lib name ... .endl, Spectre and VACASK section ... endsection), in file order. Absent: none.

SpectreAnalysis.description: The analysis a Spectre sweep or montecarlo runs inside it. SpiceRack writes it lowercase and also reads other cases.

Sweep.description: How a frequency sweep spaces its points: per decade, per octave, in total (lin), or log-spaced in total (Spectre). SpiceRack writes it lowercase and also reads other cases.

Subcircuit.description: Named, parameterized, composable circuit fragment -- the unit of reuse.

verilog_blocks.description: Verilog blocks to co-simulate or synthesize. Absent: none.

conditionals.description: Conditional blocks (.if/.elseif/.else/.endif, Spectre if/else, VACASK @if), after the body's other cards. Absent: none.

statistics.description: Spectre statistics blocks, as the Spectre importer reads them. Absent: none.

locals.description: A definition's own .param cards (SPICE .param inside a .subckt): computed in the body, never set by an instance; in card order. Absent: none.

Conditional.description: A conditional block: the cards of its first branch whose condition holds.

at.description: Where the block sat among its body's components; absent: after them.

Branch.description: One branch: its condition (absent: else) and the cards it selects.

truncate.description: truncate tr= of the block, process and mismatch; null inherits.

LibSection.description: One library section: a Subcircuit body (name: the section's; no ports) plus the .subckt definitions inside it.

library.description: The Spectre library the section sits in. Absent: a bare section (SPICE, VACASK, or Spectre outside a library).

subcircuit_defs.description: The .subckt definitions in the section. Absent: none.

ParamDef.description: Parameter definition with optional default value.

Instance.description: Reference to a Subcircuit definition with port mapping and parameter overrides.

at.description: Where the instance sat among its subcircuit's components, as read: before components[at]. Absent: after them all.

kind.description: Model type, e.g. NMOS, PMOS, NPN, D

Component.description: All SPICE component types as structured data. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

model.description: The .model the card names (R1 a b rmod l=10u); the value is then empty. Absent: null.
The .model the card names (R1 a b rmod l=10u); the value is then empty. Absent: null.
The .model the card names (R1 a b rmod l=10u); the value is then empty. Absent: null.

port.description: An RF port for .sp (ngspice portnum n z0 x, manual 4.1.11): z0 ohms in series in every analysis. Absent: no port.

oneOf.description: A charge-defined capacitor (ngspice C n+ n- Q='expr'): charge is the charge from n1 to n2 as an expression, without SPICE delimiters.

extra_nodes.description: Nodes after the last named one, in card order (VDMOS thermal, SOI body and back gate). Absent: none.

nb.description: The bulk node; null on a 3-terminal VDMOS.

extra_nodes.description: Nodes after the last named one, in card order (VDMOS thermal, SOI body and back gate). Absent: none.

oneOf.description: E/F/G/H POLY(n): controls are node pairs (E, G) or source names (F, H); coeffs in SPICE term order.

IrValue.description: Component value -- numeric, expression, or raw text.

repeat.description: ngspice r=: the time the sequence repeats from, forever. Absent: once.

delay.description: ngspice td=: the whole sequence delayed by this time. Absent: no delay.

oneOf.description: ngspice TRNOISE(NA NT NALPHA NAMP RTSAM RTSCAPT RTSEMT), added to the DC value (ngspice manual 4.1.7). ngspice only.
ngspice TRRANDOM(TYPE TS TD PARAM1 PARAM2), added to the DC value (ngspice manual 4.1.8). ngspice only.

Testbench.description: Wraps a DUT with stimulus, analyses, and simulation options.

dut.description: Ignored. Written before 0.1.3; the DUT is the circuit's top.

prints.description: .print/.plot cards: what a SPICE run prints to stdout. Absent: none.

ngbehavior.description: ngspice compatibility mode in lowercase letters ("hsa"), passed as `ngspice -D ngbehavior=<mode>`; other dialects ignore it. Absent or null: none.

PrintCard.description: One .print card: the analysis (tran, dc, ...; empty if none named) and its output expressions.

Analysis.description: All supported analyses as a tagged union, discriminated by the 'type' field.

tf_type.description: vol or cur (any case on load).

pz_type.description: pol, zer or pz (any case on load).

sc_iter.description: ngspice sciter: shooting iterations (default 50). Absent: unset.

steady_coeff.description: ngspice steadycoeff: the convergence weight (default 1e-3). Absent: unset.

uic.description: ngspice uic: skip the operating point. Absent: false.

variations.description: process, mismatch or all (R19 p.166). Absent: Spectre's default.

SimOptions.description: Simulation options -- portable settings plus per-backend overrides.

ModelLibrary.description: Opaque PDK/model library reference with per-backend path overrides.

setup_includes.description: Files every backend includes before the library. Absent: none.

FeatureFlags.description: Feature flags computed from IR content.

IrNum.description: A waveform parameter: a number, or the text of an expression over .params (vdd/2). JSON keeps a number a number.

IrNumPair.description: A PWL point [time, value], each an IrNum.

Dialect.description: A netlist language, by its lowercase name.

FuncDef.description: A .func: name(args) = body, the body an expression over the arguments and parameters.

VerilogBlock.description: A Verilog module instance, co-simulated through XSPICE d_cosim (Simulate) or synthesized to standard cells (Synthesize).

connections.description: Module port -> one net, or a bus as a list of nets.

StringPair.description: A two-element tuple serialized as a JSON array: [string, string].

NumberPair.description: A two-element tuple serialized as a JSON array: [number, number].

StringNumberPair.description: A two-element tuple serialized as a JSON array: [string, number].
